heard: From the sons of Cush, Saba his name Havilah, Sattah and Ramah The sons of Ramah, Sheba and Dedan A line of nations known by name Cush father Nimrod, mighty on earth A hunter before the Lord, it is said Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter Kingdoms of Babel, Erech and Akkad Sons of Shin, the older brother
